title: Ali jaisa ho
body:
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
<<DIVIDER>>
ay ummate nabawi aisi ho zindagi
zeenat ho ali ki kirdaar tumhara ho
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
<<DIVIDER>>
tum aale nabi ki aan bano
wallah mard e maidan bano
ay momino kaam wo kar jaana
sajde mein sar ko katwana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ajr e risaalat yaad rahe
asghar ki shahadat yaad rahe
akbar ki azaan ye kehti hai
quran ka muhafiz kehlana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo tauq e garan wo zanjeerein
wo pusht pe zulm ki tehreerein
bazaar e sitam mein tafseerein
khutbe mein wo lejha apnaana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ka seena yaad rahe
mazloom sakina yaad rahe
itrat ka nagina yaad rahe
mushkil mein na tera ghabrana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis pe zinda islam rahe
bas pesh e nazar wo kaam rahe
aijaaz mawaddat ki khaatir
kar daalo dil ka nazrana
ali jaisa ho ali jaisa
ay ummate nabawi...
author: Aijaaz ali
